report.explanation: Alert shows checkout 200s with one 344ms outlier; traces show all spans 200/ok, no errors, no pool exhaustion (pool size 1, idle 1), no redis timeouts, memory retained 3-4MB vs 32MB limit. Metrics show checkout p95 425ms but zero 502s. No evidence substantiates any taxonomy cause; insufficient to bound a root cause.
missing_evidence: Latency baseline for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms/425ms p95 is anomalous
Error or timeout logs/spans for downstream order, payment, inventory, redis, postgres
Sustained memory-retention time series to assess leak vs transient allocation
Deployment/version change records correlated with latency shift
